title: Guest's attempt to show Aldrin UAP imagery

tellings.quote: I've actually tried to approach him uh through one of his assistants at Balls Alter Ventures about showing him some of the Apollo 11 imagery of UAP that I've found uh and also the Apollo 17 imagery. I got a polite reply

plain: A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani says he tried to reach the astronaut Buzz Aldrin, who walked on the Moon, to show him unexplained objects he says he found in photographs from Apollo 11 and Apollo 17, two of NASA's Moon missions. He says he wrote through one of Aldrin's assistants at Buzz Aldrin Ventures, the astronaut's company, and got a polite reply. He tells it himself, as part of his case that the Moon missions caught things NASA has not explained.
